messages:
maya: starting thread for v6-beta promote (fp16 -> int4-mix). Early eval shows win on cost but a spotty regress on multi-document synth summaries. Want to lock down slice-protection + auto-fallback rules.
oscar: please paste the deltas and sample counts.
maya: short: multi-doc slice (>=3 docs merged) n=2.6k, MRR -2.0, rouge-L -1.4, hallucination classifier +0.8. global n=110k, global MRR -0.25. p95 latency global -22ms, multi-doc p95 +82ms.
frank: n=2.6k is borderline. I'd prefer CI-based rule: require bootstrap 95% CI lower bound < -1.2% AND samples>=2500 to trigger hard-fallback. Otherwise mark watch.
oscar: add slice-sensitivity: multiply effect_floor by 1.3 for multi-doc (they're fragile). Also require delta > 1.6*stderr to avoid noisy flips.
maya: ops-bot shows canary id cny-17999-v6 started routing 4% at 1799994000. smoke 44/46, two fails are multi-doc.
ops-bot: canary cny-17999-v6 deployed at 1799994022. smoke: fail=2. perf: multi-doc p95 +82ms.
frank: latency guard: if p95 >70ms for 10m -> soft-throttle (reduce by 50% for 20m). Hard rollback if >140ms for 5m.
oscar: also enforce min-prompt-length-aware sample: require at least 1k requests with merged-doc tokencount>5000 to rely on multi-doc stats. This helps avoid triggering on a few long merges.
maya: dropping a compact policy blob ops can push: 

```json
{"auto_fallback":{"global":{"bootstrap_ci_pct":95,"effect_floor_pct":1.2,"min_samples":10000,"persistence_mins":15},"slices":{"multi_doc":{"effect_floor_pct":1.2,"sensitivity_mult":1.3,"min_samples":2500,"immediate_if_hallucinate_pct":0.6}},"latency":{"p95_soft_ms":70,"p95_hard_ms":140,"soft_throttle_pct":50},"watch_only":{"global_mrr_pct":0.35,"slice_mrr_pct":0.5}}
```

maya: hysteresis: require rule true in 2 consecutive 5m windows to auto-act (unless slice.immediate==true). cooldown: 45m after rollback before auto-promote allowed.
frank: I'll run a jackknife/bootstrap hybrid on multi-doc slice to get stderr and CI. ETA ~22m.
oscar: enable 18h shadow-run for this variant so we can gather more multi-docs without expanding user routing. Also wire alerts to #incidents for slice immediate triggers.
maya: ops, ops-bot, please export failing prompts to secure bucket and tag with anonymized prompt-hash. Don't forget to remove PII.
ops-bot: shadow-run enabled for cny-17999-v6 for 18h starting 1799997200. will export fails to s3://redwood-secure/evals/cny-17999 with redaction.
frank: bootstrap result: multi-doc MRR delta -2.05%, bootstrap 95% CI lower = -2.95%, upper = -1.12%, samples=2.6k. stderr ~0.51%. delta > 1.6*stderr and lower CI < -1.2.
maya: per policy that triggers hard-fallback for slice. rolling back now. deploy-bot please execute.
deploy-bot: rolling back canary cny-17999-v6: routing 4% -> 0% starting 1799999160. status: in-progress.
oscar: filing short debrief: (1) add multi-doc slice to default protected-slices, (2) schedule focused eval harness that replays merged-doc sessions with int4 kernels + KV, (3) try small quant-aware fine-tune on the failing slice and re-test in shadow.
maya: agree. closing thread once postmortem doc is linked. thanks everyone. :rocket:
